CONNECT YOUR MAP

Real roads. Real elevation.

Add a browser-restricted Google Maps API key to calculate a route and discover nearby chargers. Google may bill your Cloud project for these requests.

  1. Enable Maps JavaScript API, Routes API, Places API (New), and Elevation API.
  2. Restrict the key to this website’s origin and those APIs.
  3. Paste your browser key below. It is held for this tab only.

Station coverage depends on Google’s data. Only identifiable selected networks and compatible CCS2 / Type 2 connectors are considered. Prices are still your manual assumptions; live occupancy is not provided.
